title: Aviary game bird permits.
bodyText: The department shall issue an aviary game bird permit to any person who raises aviary game birds and shall adopt rules pursuant to chapter 91 to effectuate this part.
bodyHtml: [§142-112]  Aviary game bird permits.  The department shall issue an aviary game bird permit to any person who raises aviary game birds and shall adopt rules pursuant to chapter 91 to effectuate this part. [L 1989, c 9, pt of §3]
